title: [DOCS]: OAuth audience handling, resource configuration, and troubleshooting
reasoning:
## Summary

Documentation closing the last open acceptance criterion from issue #4384.  Stacked on #4476 (hybrid features); base must be ``feat/oauth-aud-resource-hybrid`` not ``main``.

## Changes

### Updated: ``docs/docs/architecture/oauth-design.md``

- **Removed** the "Known Gap: No local audience/scope pre-validation" admonition (no longer applies after #4404 + #4476).
- **Added** new "Audience handling and RFC 8707" section explaining:
  - The three-stage audience resolution: explicit config -> learned from IdP -> origin fallback
  - The authoritative-vs-advisory validation distinction
  - Implementation references with file:line links

### Created: ``docs/docs/manage/oauth-resource-configuration.md`` (new)

End-user guide covering:

- When you don't need to do anything (most cases auto-derive + auto-learn)
- When to set the field explicitly (multi-tenant Entra ID, multiple audiences, recovery)
- Provider patterns for Salesforce, Azure AD, Authentik, ServiceNow, Keycloak
- Multi
